notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.1[/b]
Thanks for your feedback and bug reports. This is a student project and most of us students have graduated. It will take a bit of time to get bugs fixed. Please let us know of any more bugs you may come across and we will try and address them as quickly as possible. This update fixes the following.

- Fixed Menu UI bugs. Menus now have full mouse control
- Added Back Button. You can now press back buttons to exit menus.
- Fixed Tutorial. Tutorial is now fully playable. Fixed bug that caused the player to be stuck.
